passages.title: Our school garden
passages.text: Our school garden is a quiet space behind the science room. A narrow path runs between pots of herbs. Two wooden benches stand beside a mango tree. During breaks, students sit there to read or talk softly. The garden is small, but its shade makes it a comfortable place to rest.

passages.title: A morning at the community library
passages.text: Last Saturday, our class visited a community library near the river. First, a volunteer showed us how donated books were sorted. Then we repaired torn covers and placed labels on the shelves. Before we left, each group recommended one book for younger readers. I had expected a quiet morning, but I discovered how much teamwork a small library needs.
